desc:
Welcome to Snatch A Slime

How to Play:

🏃 Outrun bosses and rescue Slimes through each zone
🟢 Bring Slimes back to your base to grow your collection
💧 Collect drops from your Slimes and sell them for Gold
🥚 Open crates to discover rarer and rarer Slimes
👟 Train on the treadmill to gain Speed
⬆️ Upgrade your treadmill, trails, and slime pen
✨ Unlock new zones, better Slimes, and more!

Event: 
Verity can be found when going to the Verity dimension through the portal. Be warned, it is a challenge

🎮 Supports Desktop, Console, Mobile, and Tablet players
